title: OpenAI caught Russians and Iranians using ChatGPT for influence campaigns
content: The company says Russian operatives used its AI chatbot to update their bosses, shedding light on influence campaigns previously not attributed to Russia.

title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln returns home to San Diego Bay
content: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned home after a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea supporting the Iran war. The extended deployment drew attention following reports of crew stress and supply shortages.

title: Suicide is up among Black Americans. We need to talk about it.
content: NPR's Michel Martin hosted a panel conversation about mental health and suicide in the Black community, exploring a difficult subject in deeply personal conversations.

title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln is returning home to San Diego
content: The USS Abraham Lincoln is returning home to San Diego Thursday after supporting the Iran war during a record long deployment of 265 uninterrupted days at sea that included reports of deteriorating conditions among its crew.

title: New U.S. indictment charges former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro with torture
content: U.S. authorities added new torture charges to their case against former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, ramping up pressure on the ousted authoritarian leader already fighting drug trafficking allegations.

title: 4 people on NASA's Crew-12 mission return to Earth after 8 months in space
content: Four people — two NASA astronauts, one from the European Space Agency and a Russian cosmonaut — spent nearly eight months at the space station, conducting spacewalks, science experiments and research.

title: White House correspondent April Ryan reflects on reporting while under attack
content: Ryan has spent decades pressing presidents for answers. She talks about access, power, race and how asking questions put her in President Trump's crosshairs. Her new book is Notes on a Blacklash.

title: South Korea to recall its ambassador to Ukraine over North Korean POW dispute
content: The South Korean announcement on Thursday came days after its President Lee Jae Myung threatened unspecified punitive steps if Ukraine refuses to apologize over the revelation.

title: South Korea test-flies its first domestically developed hypersonic weapon
content: The test follows North Korea's recent hypersonic missile test. Tensions between the Koreas have increased after land mine explosions injured three South Korean soldiers near the border. North Korea denies responsibility.

title: Isaias intensifies to hurricane. And, judge orders Pike execution evidence preserved
content: People in the Gulf are preparing for bad weather this weekend after Isaias intensified into a hurricane. And, a judge has ordered Christa Pike's failed execution evidence be preserved.
